title: CNPC Commissions China's Longest CO2 Pipeline
summary: CNPC has commissioned the 277.6 km Jilin Petrochemical–Jilin Oilfield CO2 transmission pipeline in Jilin Province, with annual capacity of up to 3.3 million tonnes and a design pressure of 14.5 MPa. It is fed by Jilin Petrochemical's 800,000 t/yr CO2 recovery unit and carries CO2 to the Jilin Oilfield for enhanced oil recovery and geological storage; CNPC plans to offer spare capacity to third-party emitters.
why_it_matters: A long-distance, high-pressure trunk line built with spare capacity for third-party emitters is a reference case for pipeline sizing and open-access trunk design in multi-emitter networks.
